svg.title: This recovers the precise debit needed for the full remainder, not only the product. For the boundary cases the same scalar rate identities give M −mk = M at k = 0 and M −(m + 1)(k −u) + |e|b = M +|e|b at u = k. The source keeps actual shrinking and eventual admissibility in the zero-exponent case, so no positive gap or degree loss is inserted in these cases. No prior existence of logarithmic rates is required. For any approaching admissible family, every internal radius tends to zero; set T = X v internal log(1/sv).
